response.description: Lakebase is now generally available in four additional Azure regions: North Central US, France Central, Germany West Central, and East Asia. This expansion provides customers with additional deployment options and broader regional availability for Lakebase workloads. The newly supported regions are: North Central US (northcentralus) France Central (francecentral) Germany West Central (germanywestcentral) East Asia (eastasia) Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Databricks Lakebase in four additional regions
